text: The Henderson filing is due in eleven days and I'm not where I need to be. Opposing counsel dumped a second amended complaint on us Friday and now half my outline is wrong. I stayed at the office until nine last night and I'll probably do the same tomorrow. It's manageable, I just need to not get distracted by anything else right now. The associate assigned to help me keeps asking if I'm okay which is — fine, but I'd rather he just did the cite-checking I asked for.
